title: ChatGPT: Shameless Sycophancy, Double Standards, Fabricated Criticism and Zero Objectivity
text: My experience with the paid version of ChatGPT has been absolutely shocking. The biggest problem is not simply that the AI makes mistakes. It is how confidently it invents criticism, mocks innocent people, and completely reverses its judgments depending on whom it believes the user wants it to support. Apparently, all you need to do is point a finger at someone, and ChatGPT will start kissing your backside and attacking that person without checking a single fact. Here is a real example from my experience. I sell handmade dolls on Vinted. A buyer offered me 280 PLN for a doll listed at 380 PLN, requesting a discount of more than 26%. I declined. I then showed ChatGPT a screenshot and expressed frustration, without specifying which person I was criticizing. Instead of asking one simple question, the AI immediately assumed I was the buyer and began ridiculing the seller. It claimed the seller was unwilling to compromise, described 100 PLN as "only" 100 PLN, and sarcastically questioned how long the seller expected to keep the item listed with such an attitude. What exactly had the seller done wrong? Absolutely nothing! The seller had simply declined to sacrifice more than a quarter of the asking price for a handmade product. Yet ChatGPT invented an entire series of negative judgments about that person without any factual justification whatsoever. When I revealed that I was actually the seller, the AI instantly reversed its position. Suddenly, the buyer's proposed discount was excessive, the seller was completely justified, and the original criticism was supposedly unacceptable. **The facts never changed. Only ChatGPT's perception of whom it should flatter changed.** Even worse, I had already spent several days discussing my sales on that exact platform with ChatGPT, including dozens of screenshots. Yet it behaved as though those conversations had never happened. This is not independent reasoning. This is blatant sycophancy. An AI system that can confidently fabricate accusations against someone merely to agree with its user is deeply unreliable. It does not distinguish between justified criticism and completely baseless personal attacks. The double standards are equally disturbing. ChatGPT sometimes refuses to endorse derogatory generalizations about particular groups, explaining that such stereotypes are unacceptable. Yet in other conversations it uses the Russian expression "infotsygane," which incorporates an ethnic reference to Roma people into a derogatory label associated with scammers. Why does the model enforce strict standards in some cases while casually reproducing ethnic stereotypes in others? Where is the consistency? Its image-generation functionality is another major disappointment. The text model and image generator often seem completely disconnected. You explain exactly what you want. ChatGPT confidently confirms that it understands. Then the image generator produces something that contradicts the instructions. You explain the mistake, receive another confident acknowledgment, and get yet another incorrect result. This can continue in an exhausting cycle. And what follows almost every failure? Another apology. "I'm sorry." "You are right." "I understand the mistake." "It won't happen again." Then the same mistake happens again. **The apologies become meaningless when the behavior never improves.** The model also makes confident assertions without adequate evidence, loses essential conversational context, contradicts its previous statements, and sometimes produces explanations that are misleading or simply false. I am paying for a service that should provide careful reasoning, consistency, honesty, and useful analysis. Instead, I have experienced blind agreement, fabricated criticism, contradictory judgments, unreliable memory, image-generation failures, and endless apologies. I do not want an AI that automatically agrees with me. I want one that can think critically, evaluate facts fairly, and disagree when necessary. **ChatGPT has completely lost my trust.** I will not renew my subscription. I cannot recommend relying on this system for objective judgments. Its confidence should never be mistaken for accuracy, fairness, or genuine reasoning.
